source.name: Player's Handbook
source.edition_evidence: The book's own text calls itself the 2024 version of the fifth edition Player's Handbook (PDF page 4).
source.page_offset_note: printed_page = pdf_page + 1 on every one of the 67 pages where a printed footer number could be read

index_basis: PDF bookmark tree for classes, subclasses, species, backgrounds, feats and spells; table rows for equipment items

groups.basis: Weapons Table rows on PDF page 214
Armor table rows on PDF page 218 (duplicates from OCR removed)
tool headings on PDF pages 219-220 (letters with OCR gaps removed), one name recovered from other book text
Adventuring Gear Table item columns on PDF page 222
vehicle table rows on PDF page 229

text_cross_check.note: OCR damages some headings, so this is a lower bound

groups.basis: page-text headings must pair with bookmark entries; bookmark names must occur on another page

bookmark_title_corrections.evidence: page heading and clean occurrences on other pages
page heading and clean occurrences on other pages

class_list_check.note: ran as a probe: every unparsed fragment was an OCR gluing artifact containing an indexed spell name; no unknown spell name appeared

groups.residual_risk: A spell whose heading is OCR-damaged, absent from the bookmark tree and absent from the readable class-list text would pass every gate.
